adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the service now unconditionally performs a refresh-token `fetch` to `https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token` immediately after reading `credential.key` (before returning the `jsforce.Connection`). There is no `try/catch` around this network call, so any network/remote failure will throw (`fetch` rejection, `response.statusText !== "OK"` -> `HttpError`, or `parseRefreshTokenResponse` throwing) and prevent the service from being constructed/used even if the existing `access_token` in `credential.key` is still valid. The diff also shows no timeout, retry, or backoff logic for this request, making it prone to causing failures/rate limiting under load.
